title: Jon and Orbs
statementMd:
Jon Snow is on the lookout for some orbs required to defeat the white walkers. There are $*k*$ different types of orbs and he needs at least one of each. One orb spawns daily at the base of a Weirwood tree north of the wall. The probability of this orb being of any kind is equal. As the north of wall is full of dangers, he wants to know the minimum number of days he should wait before sending a ranger to collect the orbs such that the probability of him getting at least one of each kind of orb is at least ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/eba7f9528c88a90f3ec0c0b5c7b7b6b6b1b68891.png), where $ε < 10^{ - 7}$.

To better prepare himself, he wants to know the answer for $*q*$ different values of $*p*_{*i*}$. Since he is busy designing the battle strategy with Sam, he asks you for your help.

## Input

First line consists of two space separated integers $*k*$, $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *k*, *q* ≤ 1000$) — number of different kinds of orbs and number of queries respectively.

Each of the next $*q*$ lines contain a single integer $*p*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$) — $*i*$-th query.

## Output

Output $*q*$ lines. On $*i*$-th of them output single integer — answer for $*i*$-th query.
statementZhMd:
乔恩正在寻找一些用于击败异鬼的宝珠。宝珠共有 $*k*$ 种不同的类型，他至少需要每种各一个。每天，一棵鱼梁木的树下都会生成一颗宝珠。生成的宝珠属于每种类型的概率相等。由于长城以北充满危险，他想知道在派遣一名游骑兵去收集宝珠之前，最少需要等待多少天，才能使收集到每种类型至少一颗宝珠的概率不低于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/eba7f9528c88a90f3ec0c0b5c7b7b6b6b1b68891.png)，其中 $ε < 10^{ - 7}$。

为了更好地做好准备，他想知道对于 $*p*_{*i*}$ 的 $*q*$ 个不同取值时的答案。由于他正忙于和山姆一起制定战斗策略，因此向你寻求帮助。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个以空格分隔的整数 $*k*$、$*q*$（$1 ≤ *k*, *q* ≤ 1000$），分别表示宝珠的种类数和询问数。

接下来的 $*q*$ 行中，每行包含一个整数 $*p*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$），表示第 $*i*$ 次询问。

## 输出格式

输出 $*q*$ 行。第 $*i*$ 行输出一个整数，表示第 $*i*$ 次询问的答案。
